mapper.sql: SELECT l.lesson_id, l.title, l.description, l.price, l.category, l.start_date, l.end_date, l.capacity, l.points_enabled, COALESCE(st.session_count, 0) AS session_count, COALESCE(st.seat_total, 0) AS seat_total, COALESCE(st.booked_count, 0) AS booked_count, st.next_session_at FROM lesson l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lesson_id, COUNT(*) AS session_count, SUM(capacity) AS seat_total, SUM(capacity - available_seats) AS booked_count, MIN(IF(start_at > NOW(), start_at, NULL)) AS next_session_at FROM lesson_session WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' GROUP BY lesson_id ) st ON st.lesson_id = l.lesson_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson (title, description, price, category, start_date, end_date, capacity, points_enabled) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{category}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{capacity}, #{pointsEnabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE lesson SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, category = #{category}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, capacity = #{capacity}, points_enabled = #{pointsEnabled} WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId}
